verdicts.reason: A: the white card runs past the left and right canvas edges, so its corners get cut off. The logo floats indented at about x=155 and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge. A large dead gap separates the logo from the headline. The CTA sits alone in the top-right corner, away from its copy. The desert imagery is cut down to a thin strip. B: the logo rides up over the card's top edge, so it collides with the boundary and sits on the background. The 'See Fares' CTA has shrunk to an unreadable pill stranded at the bottom. A big empty gap opens below the subhead, and 'away' is left as an orphan. B does keep the dunes and reads as a better left-to-right split, but its illegible CTA and logo collision are worse than A's misalignment.
